ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Wal-layli idha yasri' in Surah Al-Fajr?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this oath by the night's creeping darkness underscores the transient nature of worldly power and the inevitability of divine retribution, mirroring the fate of the 'People of the Elephant' mentioned in the preceding verse. It serves as a solemn reminder that just as the night yields to dawn, the oppressors will eventually be overthrown by God's justice, a theme central to the Surah's narrative of historical cycles.
